dict.string: MP3 Download needs to capture system audio output so it can record streaming music to MP3 files.
MP3 Download uses the Microphone permission category to access Core Audio process taps for system-wide audio capture. No physical microphone audio is recorded.
MP3 Download needs to capture system audio so it can record streaming music to MP3 files.
MP3 Download needs Screen Recording permission to capture system-wide audio output. No screen content is captured or recorded — audio only.
MP3 Download asks Music, Spotify, and Amazon Music for the current track title so files can be tagged with the song name.
